Prophecy: The Lord Descends, the Dead Rise, the Living Are Caught Up
ProphecySummary: By the word of the Lord, Paul says those alive and remaining at the Lord's coming will not precede those who are asleep: the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, the voice of the archangel, and the trump of God, the dead in Christ will rise first, and then the living remaining will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so be ever with the Lord.
Fulfillment: Awaited. The descent, the shout and trump, the rising of the dead in Christ first, and the catching up of the living have not yet occurred; the distinctive detail here (order of dead before living, meeting in the air) is what separates this entry from the generic second-coming rows.
